heading: 16.4 What the standard library does not carry
text:
### 16.4 What the standard library does not carry [LUNI.16.4]

No `units.archaic` module. Units from defunct or field-specific historical
systems (apothecary, surveying chains, cubit, etc.) are not in the standard
library. Authors who need them declare them locally using the same
`unit <name>: <dimension> = <expr>` syntax.
